name: vaultrobbers-mint
description: Vault Robbers multichain mint hub (vaultrobbers.com). Pay in any currency via Wrapping Companion + Relay, mint on Robinhood Chain. Runtime-configurable USD buffer + destinations. Includes V1/V2 immortalized-stats showcase tabs.

tables.name: vrmint_config
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vrmint_config (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT, updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

tables.name: vrmint_orders
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vrmint_orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, minter TEXT, qty INTEGER, tier_price_rvlt TEXT, usd_subtotal REAL, buffer_pct REAL, usd_total REAL, pay_currency TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'quoted', tx TEXT, net INTEGER, ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

tables.name: vr_buyburn
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vr_buyburn (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, source TEXT, rvlt_amount REAL, usd REAL, tx TEXT, net INTEGER DEFAULT 4663, ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

tables.name: vrmint_premium_used
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vrmint_premium_used (tx_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, minter TEXT, qty INTEGER, wei TEXT, used_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

tables.name: vrmint_vouchers
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vrmint_vouchers (minter TEXT, qty INTEGER, nonce TEXT, deadline INTEGER, issued_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

tables.name: vrmint_free_credits
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vrmint_free_credits (minter TEXT PRIMARY KEY, qty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, redeemed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reason TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

tables.name: vrmint_owed
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vrmint_owed (minter TEXT PRIMARY KEY, qty_short INTEGER, eth_wei TEXT, note TEXT, flagged_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
